what_it_is: Variable stiffness, single lumen microcatheter designed to access small, tortuous vasculature. Hydrophilic coating provides lubricity for vessel navigation. PTFE-lined inner lumen facilitates movement of guidewires and other devices. Proprietary braid construction provides balance of stability (braid section) and navigability (coil section).
sizing_specs: Distal tip extension past distal marker: as little as 0.5 mm; TRUELUMEN Technology provides consistent inner diameter throughout length; In-line marker bands
compatible_with: CEREBASE DA Guide Sheath, CEREGLIDE 71 Intermediate Catheter, EMBOTRAP III Revascularization Device, EMBOGUARD Balloon Guide Catheter, guidewires and interventional devices
use_notes: TRUELUMEN Technology provides consistent ID throughout catheter length. Shorter distal tip past marker provides more accurate tip position representation under fluoroscopy. Part of the CERENOVUS Stroke Solutions system.
